Team — looping you on Jordan's note. Summary: SierraWorks will likely push payment to ~2027-05-03 due to an internal allocation freeze. They need remit-to confirmation and a W-9.

Proposed plan:
- Confirm remit-to address and remit reference string to Jordan today (I can do that).
- Mark an ACH to be expected on 2027-05-03. Finance (Laura/Rishi) to watch ledger and apply ASAP on receipt.
- Contingency: if ACH fails or is delayed beyond 5 business days, we ask for a one-time card authorization (they can pre-authorize an amount for the outstanding invoice) OR we request a same-day wire.
- Priyom, please prepare a short one-page fallback authorization form we can send to Jordan (card pre-auth + wire notice).

Attachments to include to Jordan: W-9 (attached), SW-INV-20270401.pdf, wire_instructions.docx.

Jordan — can you confirm the payer entity name (full legal name for W-9 cross-check) and the internal remit reference you plan to use? If any part of this needs different routing (AP portal, invoice upload), say so and we'll adapt.

Thanks,
Diego

Thanks for the heads up. We will expect an ACH deposit on Monday, 3 May 2027. Please include the following remittance reference exactly: REDWOOD-SW-20270401. That will let our billing engine lock and reconcile automatically.

Remit-to (for AP record): Redwood Inference, Attn: AR Receipts, 4030 Market St, Suite 200, San Francisco, CA 94114.

If your team prefers a card pre-auth instead of a wire, please confirm and we will send the one-page authorization for signature.

Best,
